method: Direct visual reading of native 224x144 PNGs, plus 4x integer nearest-neighbor enlargements for Y1 AP/SP inspection
interpolation: NEAREST; no smoothing; native originals retained
findings: The Y1 overlay appears in both battle fixtures and displays the inherited AP/SP labels and numerical values inside the player deck panel.
AP/SP data disappears when Y1 is released; player deck graphics match the ordinary English ROM on both entry and release checkpoints.
No new clipping, displaced tiles, missing glyphs or residual AP/SP pixels were observed in the reviewed images; compared complete RC6 frames and WRAM are identical to MANT04 RC6.
The opponent deck differs intentionally from ordinary English after RC6 initialization. All such differences also exist in the verified MANT04 RC6 baseline.
limitations: Direct review covers the listed battle frames and the two supplied fixtures; it is not a review of every RC6 layout or battle combination.
The emulator fixtures are inherited synthetic setups; no natural progression or physical hardware result is inferred.
This review preserves the inherited RC6 overlay appearance and does not claim reconstruction of its unavailable assembly source.
direct_final_reading: Y1 held at 4x NEAREST and release at native resolution re-read in both scenarios after final SORT revision; entry native captures match the preceding directly reviewed captures by SHA-256.
